body: Operator report: during an upstream error burst the service ran out of database connections and never recovered, even after the upstream healed. app/pool.py ConnectionPool.run() acquires a connection, calls fn(conn), and only releases on the success path — when fn raises, the connection leaks. One leaked connection per failure exhausts a small pool fast. Fix run() so the connection is always released whether fn succeeds or raises, and fn's exception still propagates unchanged to the caller. Acceptance: after a raising fn, pool.in_use returns to 0 and the same pool (max_size=1) can run successfully again repeatedly, including after multiple consecutive failures; successful results and exceptions are otherwise unchanged; existing tests still pass.
title: Connection pool leaks connections on the error path
